```{r}

#############################################################################################################

# Replication asymmetry analysis of hPu-hPy motifs using OK-seq data
# - Identifies the 100 most abundant hPu-hPy motifs from Simple Repeat annotations
# - Filters motifs to retain non-homopolymeric and non-symmetric repeat families
# - Selects repeat motifs with unit lengths ≤ 8 nucleotides
# - Annotates repeat loci as transcribed (Genic) or non-transcribed (Intergenic) using GENCODE transcript coordinates
# - Imports OK-seq replication fork directionality (RFD) datasets from multiple cell lines
# - Assigns repeat loci to positive or negative replication fork orientation domains
# - Calculates motif-specific replication asymmetry as the POS/NEG ratio
# - Computes asymmetry scores using |log2(POS/NEG)|
# - Aggregates motifs into biologically related repeat-family groups
# - Compares replication asymmetry between hPu/hPy-forming repeat families and other repeats
# - Evaluates asymmetry separately in genic and intergenic regions
# - Generates asymmetry scatterplots with repeat-family annotation labels
# - Performs non-parametric statistical analyses:
#     - Kruskal-Wallis tests across repeat families
#     - Pairwise Wilcoxon tests with Benjamini-Hochberg correction
#     - hPu-hPy versus Other repeat-family comparisons
#     - Genic versus intergenic comparisons
#     - Family-specific genic/intergenic comparisons
# - Creates formatted summary tables of all statistical results
# - Exports graphical outputs and statistical results as figures and Excel files
#
# Requirements:
#   - dplyr
#   - ggplot2
#   - tidyr
#   - ggrepel
#   - forcats
#   - rstatix
#   - data.table
#   - openxlsx
#   - GenomicRanges
#   - IRanges
#   - rtracklayer

#############################################################################################################

# Packages installation CRAN + BIOCONDUCTOR
cran_pkgs <- c(
  "dplyr",
  "ggplot2",
  "tidyr",
  "ggrepel",
  "forcats",
  "rstatix",
  "data.table",
  "openxlsx"
)

bioc_pkgs <- c(
  "GenomicRanges",
  "rtracklayer"
)

# Utility function: install only missing CRAN packages
install_missing_cran <- function(pkgs) {
  missing <- pkgs[!pkgs %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"]]
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    install.packages(
      missing,
      repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org"
    )
  }
}

# Utility function: install only missing Bioconductor packages
install_missing_bioc <- function(pkgs) {
  if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(
      "BiocManager",
      repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org"
    )
  }

  missing <- pkgs[!pkgs %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"]]
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    BiocManager::install(
      missing,
      ask = FALSE,
      update = FALSE
    )
  }
}

# Install missing packages
install_missing_cran(cran_pkgs)
install_missing_bioc(bioc_pkgs)

message("All required packages are installed.")

# Load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(ggrepel)
library(forcats)
library(rstatix)
library(data.table)
library(openxlsx)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(rtracklayer)

#############################################################################################################

# Create the top100 8nt motif file
# Read input file
df <- read.table("/simpleRepeathg19/bed/file/path",sep = "\t",header = FALSE,stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

retirer_motifs_sym <- function(df, col = "V17") {
  motifs_sym <- c("AT", "TA", "CG", "GC")
  df[!(df[[col]] %in% motifs_sym), ]
}

df <- df[!grepl("^[AT]+$", df$V17) &
         !grepl("^[CG]+$", df$V17), ]

df <- retirer_motifs_sym(df)

top100_df <- df %>%
  count(V17, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 100)

# Top 100 motifs
top100_motifs <- df %>%
  count(V17, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 100) %>%
  pull(V17)

# Keep all the motif lines corresponding to Top100
top100_df <- df %>%
  filter(V17 %in% top100_motifs) %>%
  select(V2, V3, V4, V17)

# Top 100 motifs the most frequent
top100_df <- df %>%
  count(V17, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 100)

# Keep only the motifs with a length < or = to 8
top100_8nt <- top100_df %>%
  filter(nchar(V17) <= 8)

motifs_8nt <- top100_8nt$V17

coord_8nt <- df %>%
  filter(V17 %in% motifs_8nt) %>%
  select(V2, V3, V4, V17)

# Save the file
write.table(coord_8nt, "/ouput/file/path",sep = "\t",quote = FALSE,row.names = FALSE)

#############################################################################################################

# Import coord_8nt bed file
coord_8nt <- fread("/coord_8nt/bed/file/path",sep = "\t",header = FALSE)

# Transcript annotation : gencode.v19.annotation.gtf file
gtf <- import("/gencode.v19.annotation.gtf/file/path")

gtf_tx <- gtf[gtf$type == "transcript"]

gr_rep <- GRanges(
  seqnames = coord_8nt$V1,
  ranges = IRanges(
    start = coord_8nt$V2 + 1,
    end = coord_8nt$V3
  )
)

hits_tx <- findOverlaps(gr_rep, gtf_tx)

coord_8nt$Transcript <- "Non_transcribed"
coord_8nt$Transcript[
  unique(queryHits(hits_tx))
] <- "Transcribed"

coord_8nt$Family <- coord_8nt$V4

# RFD OKseq files
rfd_files <- c(
  cellline1 = "/rfd/file/path/cellline1",
  cellline2 = "/rfd/file/path/cellline2",
  cellline3 = "/rfd/file/path/cellline3",
  cellline4 = "/rfd/file/path/cellline4"
)

# Ratio computation
compute_family <- function(rfd_files, cellline){
  cat("Processing:", cellline, "\n")
  rfd_regions <- import(rfd_files)
  hits <- findOverlaps(gr_rep, rfd_regions)
  mean_rfd <- rep(NA_real_, length(gr_rep))
  u <- unique(queryHits(hits))
  mean_rfd[u] <-
  as.numeric(
    mcols(rfd_regions)$name[
      subjectHits(hits)[match(u, queryHits(hits))]
    ]
  )

  tmp <- coord_8nt
  tmp$RFD <- mean_rfd
  tmp <- tmp %>%
    mutate(
      Orientation = case_when(
        RFD > 0 ~ "POS",
        RFD < 0 ~ "NEG",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Orientation))
  tmp %>%
    group_by(
      Family,
      Transcript,
      Orientation
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      Count = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      CellLine = cellline
    )
}

# All cell lines
all_family <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    names(rfd_files),
    function(cl)
      compute_family(
        rfd_files[cl],
        cl
      )
  )
)

# Universe of cell line object
universe_family <- all_family %>%
  group_by(
    Family,
    Transcript,
    Orientation
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = sum(Count),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    CellLine = "Universe"
  )

all_family <- bind_rows(
  all_family,
  universe_family
)

family_groups <- list(
  "AG GA CT TC" = c("AG","GA","CT","TC"),
  "AAG AGA GAA / CTT TCT TTC" = c("AAG","AGA","GAA", "CTT","TCT","TTC"),
  "AAAG AAGA AGAA GAAA / CTTT TCTT TTCT TTTC" = c("AAAG","AAGA","AGAA","GAAA", "CTTT","TCTT","TTCT","TTTC","TTTCT","TTTCTT"),
  "AAGG AGGA GAAG GGAA / CCTT CTTC TCCT TTCC" = c("AAGG","AGGA","GAAG","GGAA", "CCTT","CTTC","TCCT","TTCC"),
  "AGGG GAGG GGAG / CCTC CTCC TTCC" = c("AGGG","GAGG","GGAG", "CCTC","CTCC","TTCC"),
  "AAAAG/TTTTC" = c("AAAAG", "TTTTC", "CTTTT"),
  "AAAAAG/TTTTTC" = c("AAAAAG", "TTTTTC","TTTTCT"),
  "AAAAAAG" = c("AAAAAAG"),
  "AAAAAAAG" = c("AAAAAAAG"),
  "GATA/TAGA" = c("GATA","TAGA","TATC","CTAT", "ATAG","GATG","CATC","TATG", "ATAC","TCTA", "AGAT","ATCT"),
  "TCCA/TCCC/ATCC/CCAT" = c("TCCA","TCCC","ATCC","CCAT","TGAA","TGGA"),
  "AC/TG" = c("AC","CA", "TG", "GT"),
  "AAC/TTG" = c("AAC","TTG","TGT"),
  "AAAC/TTTG" = c("CAAA","TTGT","TTTG","GTTT","TGTT"),
  "AAAAC/TTTTG" = c("AAACA","CAAAA","AAAAC", "TTGTT","TTTGT","GTTTT","TTTTG","TGTTT"),
  "AAAAAC/TTTTTG" = c("AAAACA","CAAAAA", "TTTTGT","TTTTTG"),
  "AAAAAAC/TTTTTTG" = c("AAAACAA", "AAAAACA", "TTTTTTG"),
  "ATGG" = "ATGG",
   "GAGAGG" =  "GAGAGG"
)

hpu_hpy_families <- c(
  "AAG AGA GAA / CTT TCT TTC",
  "AAAG AAGA AGAA GAAA / CTTT TCTT TTCT TTTC",
  "AAGG AGGA GAAG GGAA / CCTT CTTC TCCT TTCC",
  "AGGG GAGG GGAG / CCTC CTCC TTCC")

universe_family <- universe_family %>%
  mutate(
    Classe = ifelse(
      Family %in% hpu_hpy_families,
      "hpu_hpy",
      "Other"
    )
  )


sort(
  setdiff(
    unique(coord_8nt$Family),
    unlist(family_groups)
  )
)

family_labels <- c(
  "AG GA CT TC" = "(GA/TC)n",
  "AAG AGA GAA / CTT TCT TTC" = "(GAA/TTC)n",
  "AAAG AAGA AGAA GAAA / CTTT TCTT TTCT TTTC" = "(GAAA/TTTC)n",
  "AAGG AGGA GAAG GGAA / CCTT CTTC TCCT TTCC" = "(GGAA/TTCC)n",
  "AGGG GAGG GGAG / CCTC CTCC TTCC" = "(GGGA/TCCC)n",
  "AAAAG/TTTTC" = "(GAAAA/TTTTC)n",
  "AAAAAG/TTTTTC" = "(GAAAAA/TTTTTC)n",
  "AAAAAAG" = "(GAAAAAA/TTTTTTC)n",
  "AAAAAAAG" = "(GAAAAAAA/TTTTTTTC)n",
  "GATA/TAGA" = "(GATA/TATC)n",
  "TCCA/TCCC/ATCC/CCAT" = "(TCCA/TGGA)n",
  "AC/TG" = "(CA/TG)n",
  "AAC/TTG" = "(CAA/TTG)n",
  "AAAC/TTTG" = "(CAAA/TTTG)n",
  "AAAAC/TTTTG" = "(CAAAA/TTTTG)n",
  "AAAAAC/TTTTTG" = "(CAAAAA/TTTTTG)n",
  "AAAAAAC/TTTTTTG" = "(CAAAAAA/TTTTTTC)n",
  "ATGG" = "(ATGG/TACC)n",
   "GAGAGG" =  "(GAGAGG/CCTCTC)n"
)

get_family_group <- function(fam) {
  for(g in names(family_groups)) {
    if(fam %in% family_groups[[g]]) {
      return(g)
    }
  }
  return(NA_character_)
}

universe_family <- universe_family %>%
  mutate(
    FamilyGroup = sapply(Family, get_family_group)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(FamilyGroup))


universe_ratio <- universe_family %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Family,
    FamilyGroup,
    Transcript,
    Orientation,
    Count,
    Classe
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Orientation,
    values_from = Count,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Ratio = (POS + 1)/(NEG + 1),
    Module = abs(log2(Ratio))
  )

universe_ratio_all <- universe_ratio %>%
  group_by(
    FamilyGroup,
    Transcript
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    MeanModule = mean(Module, na.rm = TRUE),
    SumModule  = sum(Module, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Classe = ifelse(
      FamilyGroup %in% hpu_hpy_families,
      "hpu_hpy",
      "Other"
    )
  ) 

family_mean <- universe_ratio %>%
  group_by(FamilyGroup, Transcript) %>%
  summarise(
    SumModule = sum(Module, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Transcript) %>%
  summarise(
    MeanSumModule = mean(SumModule, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


family_score <- universe_ratio %>%
  group_by(
    FamilyGroup,
    Transcript,
    Family
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    SumModule = sum(Module, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    FamilyGroup,
    Transcript
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Score = mean(SumModule, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Classe = ifelse(
      FamilyGroup %in% hpu_hpy_families,
      "hpu_hpy",
      "Other"
    )
  )


family_score <- family_score %>%
  mutate(
    Label = family_labels[FamilyGroup]
  )

t <- ggplot(family_score,aes(x = "", y = Score,colour = Classe)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(size = Classe),width = 0.15,height = 0) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = Label),colour = "black", size = 2,max.overlaps = Inf,box.padding = 0.3,point.padding = 0.2,show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~Transcript) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(hpu_hpy = "red",Other = "grey40")) +
  scale_size_manual(values = c(hpu_hpy = 4,Other = 2.5)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(y = "Mean(log2(Ratio))",x = "") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),axis.title.x = element_blank(),legend.position = "none")

print(t)

ggsave("/asymetry/plot/output/path", plot = t,width = 10,height = 6)

#############################################################################################################

# Statistics
# Score calculation by motif and transcription
motif_stats <- universe_ratio %>%
  mutate(
    Transcript = recode(
      Transcript,
      "Transcribed" = "Genic",
      "Non_transcribed" = "Intergenic"
    ),
    Score = Module,
    Classe = ifelse(
      FamilyGroup %in% hpu_hpy_families,
      "hpu_hpy",
      "Other"
    )
  )

# Kruskal-Wallis test 
kruskal_results <- motif_stats %>%
  group_by(Transcript) %>%
  group_modify(~ {

    test <- kruskal.test(
      Score ~ FamilyGroup,
      data = .x
    )

    data.frame(
      Statistic = unname(test$statistic),
      Degrees_freedom = unname(test$parameter),
      P_value = test$p.value
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

# Pairwise comparison between families
pairwise_results <- motif_stats %>%
  group_by(Transcript) %>%
  pairwise_wilcox_test(
    Score ~ FamilyGroup,
    p.adjust.method = "BH"
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Family_1 = unname(family_labels[group1]),
    Family_2 = unname(family_labels[group2])
  )

# Wilcoxon test hpu_hpy vs Others
wilcox_results <- motif_stats %>%
  group_by(Transcript) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    test <- wilcox.test(
      Score ~ Classe,
      data = .x,
      exact = FALSE
    )
    data.frame(
      Statistic = unname(test$statistic),
      P_value = test$p.value
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

# Comparaison genic vs Intergenic
transcription_stats <- motif_stats %>%
  dplyr::select(
    FamilyGroup,
    Family,
    Transcript,
    Score
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Transcript,
    values_from = Score
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Genic),
    !is.na(Intergenic)
  )

global_transcription_test <- wilcox.test(
  transcription_stats$Genic,
  transcription_stats$Intergenic,
  paired = TRUE,
  exact = FALSE
)

table_global_transcription <- data.frame(
  Comparison = "Genic vs Intergenic",
  N_motifs = nrow(transcription_stats),
  Statistic = unname(global_transcription_test$statistic),
  P_value = global_transcription_test$p.value
) %>%
  mutate(
    Significance = case_when(
      P_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      P_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
      P_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
  )

# Wilcoxon test comparing family groups (Genic vs Intergenic)
family_transcription_tests <- transcription_stats %>%
  group_by(FamilyGroup) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    test <- wilcox.test(
      .x$Genic,
      .x$Intergenic,
      paired = TRUE,
      exact = FALSE
    )

    data.frame(
      N_motifs = nrow(.x),
      Statistic = unname(test$statistic),
      P_value = test$p.value
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    P_adjusted_BH = p.adjust(P_value, method = "BH"),
    Family_Label = unname(family_labels[FamilyGroup]),
    Significance = case_when(
      P_adjusted_BH < 0.001 ~ "***",
      P_adjusted_BH < 0.01 ~ "**",
      P_adjusted_BH < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
  )

table_family_transcription <- family_transcription_tests %>%
  transmute(
    Family_Label,
    N_motifs,
    Statistic,
    P_value,
    P_adjusted_BH,
    Significance
  )

# Statistic table creation
# Table of Kruskal-Wallis test
table_kruskal <- kruskal_results %>%
  mutate(
    Comparison = "All families",
    P_value_format = ifelse(
      P_value < 0.001, "< 0.001",
      sprintf("%.4f", P_value)
    ),
    Significance = case_when(
      P_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      P_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
      P_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Transcript,
    Comparison,
    P_value,
    Significance
  )

# Table of pairwise comparison between families (Wilcoxon test)
table_pairwise <- pairwise_results %>%
  mutate(
    Family_1 = unname(family_labels[group1]),
    Family_2 = unname(family_labels[group2]),
    P_value_format = ifelse(
      p < 0.001, "< 0.001",
      sprintf("%.4f", p)
    ),
    P_adjusted_format = ifelse(
      p.adj < 0.001, "< 0.001",
      sprintf("%.4f", p.adj)
    )
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    Transcript,
    Comparison = paste(Family_1, "vs", Family_2),
    P_value = p,
    P_adjusted_BH = p.adj,
  ) %>%
  arrange(Transcript, P_adjusted_BH)

# Table hpu_hpy vs Other
table_hpu_hpy <- wilcox_results %>%
  mutate(
    Comparison = "hpu_hpy vs Other",
    P_value_format = ifelse(
      P_value < 0.001, "< 0.001",
      sprintf("%.4f", P_value)
    ),
    Significance = case_when(
      P_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      P_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
      P_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Transcript,
    Comparison,
    P_value,
    Significance
  )


# Table of global transcription comparison (Wilcoxon test)
table_global_transcription <- table_global_transcription %>%
  mutate(
    P_value_format = ifelse(
      P_value < 0.001, "< 0.001",
      sprintf("%.4f", P_value)
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Comparison,
    Statistic,
    P_value,
    Significance
  )

# Table of comparison between the same family group genic vs intergenic (Wilcoxon test)
table_family_transcription <- family_transcription_tests %>%
  transmute(
    Family = unname(family_labels[FamilyGroup]),
    P_value,
    P_adjusted_BH,
   Significance
  ) %>%
  arrange(P_adjusted_BH)

# Creation of excel file
wb <- createWorkbook()
tables <- list(
  "Kruskal_Wallis" = table_kruskal,
  "Family_comparisons" = table_pairwise,
  "hpu_hpy_vs_Other" = table_hpu_hpy,
  "Global_Transcription" = table_global_transcription,
  "Transcription_by_family" = table_family_transcription
)

header_style <- createStyle(
  fontColour = "white",
  fgFill = "black",
  textDecoration = "bold",
  halign = "center",
  border = "Bottom"
)

for (sheet_name in names(tables)) {
  addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
  writeData(
    wb,
    sheet_name,
    tables[[sheet_name]]
  )
  n_cols <- ncol(tables[[sheet_name]])
  addStyle(
    wb,
    sheet_name,
    header_style,
    rows = 1,
    cols = 1:n_cols,
    gridExpand = TRUE
  )
  freezePane(
    wb,
    sheet_name,
    firstRow = TRUE
  )
  addFilter(
    wb,
    sheet_name,
    rows = 1,
    cols = 1:n_cols
  )
  setColWidths(
    wb,
    sheet_name,
    cols = 1:n_cols,
    widths = "auto"
  )
}

# Save the table
output_file <- "/statistical/results/excel/output/path"

saveWorkbook(wb,output_file,overwrite = TRUE)

cat("Excel saved:", output_file)

#############################################################################################################

```
